Enapter
Enapter is the company that manufactures the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0.<SEP>Enapter is the manufacturer of the EL40 hydrogen electrolyzer and the developer of its associated Energy Management System (EMS).

Technical Specifications
Technical specifications are the documented technical parameters of the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0, presented in a table format.

AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0
AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0 is an anion exchange membrane electrolyser product manufactured by Enapter, with documented technical specifications.

Water Electrolysis
Water electrolysis is the electrochemical process used by the EL40 to produce hydrogen gas, consuming approximately 420 mL/h of water at 25 °C.

El40
The EL40 is a hydrogen electrolyzer device manufactured by Enapter, producing up to 500 NL/h of hydrogen with output pressures up to 35 barg, weighing 42 kg and measuring 482 mm × 635 mm × 266 mm.

Astm D1193-06
ASTM D1193-06 is a water quality standard specifying Type IV (minimum) or Type II/III (recommended) conductivity levels for water input to the EL40 electrolyzer.

Enapter Ems
The Enapter EMS (Energy Management System) is a fully automatic control and monitoring system for the EL40, operating via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

Ukca Mark
The UKCA Mark is a conformity certification for the EL40, granted according to the Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.

Hydrogen
Hydrogen is the gaseous output of the EL40 electrolyzer, with purity levels of 99.9% at 35 barg and 98.8% at 8 barg, measured by H₂O and O₂ content.

Ce Mark
The CE Mark is a conformity certification for the EL40, granted according to the Machine Directive 2006/42/CE.

Csa/Ansi B22734:2023
CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 is a standard for Hydrogen Generators Using Water Electrolysis covering industrial, commercial, and residential applications, to which the EL40 conforms.

Modbus Tcp
Modbus TCP is a communication protocol used by the Enapter EMS for control and monitoring of the EL40 over Ethernet.

Wi-Fi
Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) is a wireless connectivity method used by the Enapter EMS for remote control and monitoring of the EL40.

Enapter Datasheet El40
The Enapter Datasheet EL40 is a technical specification document containing detailed parameters including production rate, purity, power consumption, dimensions, and conformity certifications for the EL40 device.

Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008
The Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 is a UK regulatory framework that forms the basis for the UKCA Mark certification of the EL40 electrolyzer.

Machine Directive 2006/42/Ce
The Machine Directive 2006/42/CE is an EU regulatory framework that forms the basis for the CE Mark certification of the EL40 electrolyzer.

Bluetooth
Bluetooth is a wireless connectivity method used by the Enapter EMS for local control and monitoring of the EL40.
